# y11-t6-equipment: unfinished starter

Read the task brief in the briefs folder and the common templates in the ZIP. All data is synthetic. Python functions deliberately raise NotImplementedError. SQL files contain TODOs, not a working schema. Design and implement your own solution.

The pack supplies initial fixtures. Add normal, boundary, invalid and failure cases from the requirements. Public fixtures are not a secure marking key. Original content CC BY 4.0; code MIT.
